PROJECT.ONCELLEDITED: if not exists (select kntplanaid from kntplana where konto='@@konto' or @@konto is null) begin exec spRaiserror 69001,'Zadani konto ne postoji u kontnom planu!' return end#update KntShemaKonta set kntplanaid=(select kntplanaid from kntplana where konto='@@konto') where KntShemaKontaid=@@KntShemaKonta

TREEROBAFORM.ONSUBMIT: if @@node=0 begin select kntshemakontaid, kr.naziv as [Klasa robe1500],ks.opis as Pojam,kp.konto as Konto from KntShemaKonta kk inner join klmasterroba kr on kk.klmasterrobaid=kr.klmasterrobaid left outer join kntshemapojam ks on kk.kntshemapojamid=ks.kntshemapojamid left outer join kntplana kp on kk.kntplanaid=kp.kntplanaid order by kr.naziv end else begin select kntshemakontaid, kr.naziv as [Klasa robe1500],ks.opis as Pojam,kp.konto as Konto from KntShemaKonta kk inner join klmasterroba kr on kk.klmasterrobaid=kr.klmasterrobaid left outer join kntshemapojam ks on kk.kntshemapojamid=ks.kntshemapojamid left outer join kntplana kp on kk.kntplanaid=kp.kntplanaid where kk.klmasterrobaid=@@node order by 1 end
